name: Hakeem Kushimo
headline: AV Technician / Video Specialist / Graphics Operator
availability: Freelance, corporate, medical, convention, and hybrid events
summary: Freelance AV technician and specialized graphics operator focused on corporate, medical, and hybrid events. Experienced in complex video signal flow, presentation management, and real-time troubleshooting for high-stakes conventions. Proven record executing multi-screen content delivery and live switching for large-scale sessions.
showKit: Multi-input HD video switcher with integrated livestream encoding and recording
Dual 4K PTZ camera system with remote control and optical zoom
Dedicated video encoder/decoder for IP video workflows
Portable multiview monitor and SDI/HDMI signal conversion tools
Live presentation direction, video switching, and graphics operation
Multi-camera production, livestreaming, and event recording
Video signal routing, monitoring, and troubleshooting

highlights: Master-level operation of PlaybackPro, Keynote, and PowerPoint to keep media delivery seamless and presentations stable.
Operate Osee GoStream Duet, Roland, and Blackmagic switchers while managing mixed SDI/HDMI inputs for live camera and graphics integration.
Provide white-glove presenter support, including slide formatting, laptop troubleshooting, and multi-display confidence monitoring.
Architect and manage hybrid workflows using vMix and OBS to synchronize in-person and remote participation.
Serve as technical lead for breakout rooms and ballrooms from initial setup through live show execution.
